name: Kingdom of Hungary

areaKm2.note: Hungary in WWII page: 117,160 km2 in 1939 (League of Nations, incl. First Vienna Award 11,927 and Carpatho-Ukraine) + N. Transylvania 43,492 + returned Yugoslav areas 11,417 = 172,069 km2 (mid). The world_1938 polygon covers only ~108,600 km2 (low).

population.note: League of Nations Year-Book 1939/40 (https://www.istmat.org/files/uploads/49915/05_strany_mira_-_territoriya_i_naselenie.pdf): 10.316M (1939, incl. First Vienna Award and Carpatho-Ukraine) + N. Transylvania 2,578,100 + returned Yugoslav areas 1,025,508 (Hungary in WWII page) = ~13.9M (low); 1941 census ~14.68M (mid). COW tpop 1941 = 9,344k refers to Trianon Hungary and is not used.

urbanization.note: HYDE (OWID) urban share Hungary (present-day borders) 1940 = 44.2% (high); the annexed territories were more rural (mid ~0.38). Low = COW upop/tpop 1941 = 1,357/9,344 = 0.15 for Trianon Hungary, ~0.1 for the enlarged state (cities over 100,000).

activePersonnel.note: Reconstruction: peace army ~250,000 in 27 light divisions (brigades) plus partial mobilisation in spring 1941 (Yugoslav campaign); the cited page lists 730,000 personnel at the wartime peak (above the high bound). Snapshot date: 27 June 1941. Check: COW NMC v7 milper 1939 = 33k (1941 missing) (annual averages, not the snapshot-date strength).

trainedReserves.note: Educated guess. Trained reservists not under arms in June 1941; rearmament only began in 1938 (Gyor programme), so the trained pool was small.

supportPersonnel.note: Artillery, engineers, trains, air force (~20,000), river forces, depots.

mobilizationRatio.note: Cited page: 730,000 personnel peak / 14.7M = 0.05 (low); ~1.5M men served over the war (~0.1, high).

mobilizable.note: population x mobilizationRatio (low x low, mid x mid, high x high).

count.note: 27 light (two-regiment) divisions of ~10,000 men; the Carpathian Group of 1 July 1941 (VIII Corps and Mobile Corps, cited page) had ~45,000 men.

gdpPerCapita.note: Maddison Project 2023 (OWID CSV, https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/gdp-per-capita-maddison-project-database.csv): Hungary (present-day borders) 1941 = 4,186 (2011 int$, high); the annexed territories (N. Transylvania, Carpatho-Ukraine, Backa) were poorer, ~2,000-2,500, giving a population-weighted ~3,800.

gdp.note: population x gdpPerCapita (low x low, mid x mid, high x high), 2011 int$.

milSpendShare.note: Educated guess. Gyor rearmament programme (1938) and war from 1941.

industrialShare.note: Educated guess. Budapest engineering (Weiss Manfred, Ganz, MAVAG), bauxite, oil from 1937.

foodSurplus.note: Educated guess. Formula: foodSurplus = 1 - agricultural share of employment. Agricultural share of employment assumed ~0.52 for the enlarged 1941 state (no fetched census figure; the annexed territories were more rural than Trianon Hungary). Grain and meat exporter.

annualCohort.note: Educated guess. Men reaching 21 per year in a population of ~14.7M.

armor.note: War-total production (1939/41-45) from the cited page's land and air tables, divided by ~4 war years. Hungary: 973 tanks and SPGs (Toldi, Turan, Zrinyi, Nimrod) and 530 other armoured vehicles.

artillery.note: War-total production (1939/41-45) from the cited page's land and air tables, divided by ~4 war years. Hungary: 447 artillery pieces.

aircraft_fighter.note: Educated guess. Fighters per year 1942-44 (Re.2000 Heja ~200, Bf 109G ~600 by Weiss Manfred over the war).

aircraft_strike.note: Educated guess. Bombers and heavy fighters per year 1942-44 (Me 210Ca ~270).

roadKm.note: Educated guess. State and county roads in the enlarged territory.

railKm.note: Educated guess. CHAT railline Hungary 1938 = 9,799 km (Trianon Hungary, read from https://data.nber.org/chat/chat.dta, low); lines in the territories annexed 1938-41 guessed.

majorPorts.note: Educated guess. Budapest (Csepel free port on the Danube); no sea port.

merchantTonnage.note: Educated guess. Deadweight tons. Small Hungarian sea-going fleet (Danube-sea ships) of ~20 vessels.

supplyRangeKm.note: Educated guess. Mobile Corps outran its supply in the Ukraine in July-August 1941.

draftAnimals.note: Educated guess. ~900,000 horses in the enlarged territory.

homeDefense.note: 1.2 row: Carpathian barrier (Arpad Line) and population support in the core.

notes: Snapshot date 27 June 1941 (declaration of war on the USSR after the Kassa bombing; the Carpathian Group attacked on 1 July). Territory = Hungary after the two Vienna Awards and the 1941 annexation of Backa and Baranya; the world_1938 basemap (nearest at or before 1941) shows only the 1938 extent, so areaKm2 mid is the real 1941 area. Most force counts are educated guesses or reconstructions: no Hungarian order-of-battle source was fetched. Ship convention per SOURCES.md naval role boundaries: battleships, carriers, cruisers and destroyers = ships_major, torpedo boats and smaller craft = ships_minor (role split per SOURCES.md naval role boundaries). audit 2026-10-30: no basemap between 1938 and 1945 shows the enlarged state; the hb:1938:Hungary polygon (~108,600 km2) omits southern Slovakia, Carpatho-Ukraine, northern Transylvania and Backa-Baranya (~63,000 km2) that population and area include.
